title: Would you want a real-time alert when you break your own trading plan?
author: ExpensiveTree4267
selftext:
i'm building a tool that flags when you break your trading plan in real time, like sizing up after a loss or entering before your setup is confirmed.

it also logs your sessions so you can see which rules you broke and spot patterns, like overtrading after a losing streak.

curious what you'd actually want it to flag while you're trading. if you want to try it when it's ready, leave your email here and i'll let you know when early access opens: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdlT38ZJVwt3bi67Oi5AGKO0ORh6c0SfeQd779se8SDwVNchQ/viewform](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdlT38ZJVwt3bi67Oi5AGKO0ORh6c0SfeQd779se8SDwVNchQ/viewform)
